market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and multiyear yield highs create headwinds for 4th+ day of S&P losses. Fed-hike bets and PPI data sustain bond sell-off. Energy and TIPS outperform; broad equities under pressure. Watch for $107 oil breakout or Iran de-escalation as binary catalyst.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure capex (chips, power, connectivity) and healthcare innovation provide structural growth. Trade war and geopolitical risk add volatility but not regime change. 6-12M: expect mean reversion in oil if Middle East stabilizes; yields normalize post-PPI shock.
